question: Does Mega Absol Z now Mega-Evolve on its first action, and does Yveltal set Tailwind?
party_reuse: Unchanged from receipt.json (seed 16); same cap 96 and location, chronology audit unchanged.

attempts.narrative: T1 Psychic Terrain denied Fake Out; two Moonblasts KO'd Yveltal before its Oblivion Wing; Flare Blitz put Flutter Mane on its Sash. T2 Flutter Mane out to Urshifu; Grimmsnarl Light Screen; Moonblast 277 into Grimmsnarl. T3 Grimmsnarl Reflect; Close Combat KO'd Incineroar, Moonblast KO'd Grimmsnarl. T4 SHARPEDO MEGA-EVOLVED ON ITS FIRST ACTION and Psychic Fangs hit Urshifu's Protect; Tapu Lele out to Sylveon, which took a crit Wicked Blow (138). T5 Mega Sharpedo Psychic Fangs OHKO'd Sylveon (240) before Hyper Voice; my Close Combat KO'd Mega Sharpedo; Sidney's Urshifu Close Combat KO'd my Urshifu. T6 Incineroar + Kangaskhan in; ABSOL ENTERED (Intimidated) AND DID NOT MEGA-EVOLVE: the trainer's one Mega was already spent on Sharpedo (state: mega_already_used true). Fake Out flinched Urshifu, Mega Double-Edge took it to 33; Absol Close Combat 2x into Kangaskhan. T7 Sucker Punch (Parental Bond) 69 into Absol; Urshifu's crit Close Combat OHKO'd Incineroar (378); Absol Close Combat KO'd Kangaskhan. T8 Tapu Lele + Flutter Mane back in (terrain reset); Flutter Mane Moonblast KO'd Absol; Wicked Blow KO'd Tapu Lele before Dazzling Gleam. T9 (no advance) Flutter Mane at 1 HP Moonblast KO'd the 33-HP Urshifu under Psychic Terrain (Sucker Punch blocked).

mega_check.board: Sharpedo 271/271 enters end of T3 beside Urshifu 325/325 vs Tapu Lele 190/271 (switching to Sylveon) and Urshifu 244/328. Mega Evolution then Psychic Fangs.

Absol 256/256 @Absolite Z enters end of T5 beside Urshifu 325/325 (-1 Def/SpD) vs Incineroar 378/378 and Kangaskhan 338/338 (Mega unused). Driver: usable_gimmick 'mega', mega_already_used TRUE. The trainer had already Mega-Evolved Sharpedo on T4, so Absol was never eligible; it chose Close Combat into Kangaskhan on T6, Close Combat again on T7 and Knock Off on T8, and was KO'd by Moonblast. This is the one-Mega-per-trainer rule, not the pair-search fix failing: the authored line carries two stones (mega_slots 5,6) and only the first holder to act can ever evolve.

strategy_checks.evidence: See mega_check. With Sharpedo evolving first every time (it is party slot 5 and enters first), Absol's stone can never fire. Reported as a legality/design problem in the authored set.
T4 Mega on its first action (no Speed Boost turn taken first); Strong Jaw Psychic Fangs OHKO'd Sylveon T5.

Crit Wicked Blow into Sylveon T4 and KO on Tapu Lele T8; crit Close Combat OHKO'd Incineroar T7.

strategy_checks.evidence: No opposing Protect; Absol attacked on entry instead of the prior run's empty Protect.

ai_defects.board: Lead Yveltal 370/370 beside Incineroar vs Tapu Lele + Flutter Mane (two Fairies, Psychic Terrain).
ai_defects.better: Tailwind (the authored TAILWIND strategy) so Incineroar and the reserves outspeed the two 135/95-speed Fairies; Yveltal cannot win the damage race into two Fairies and died before acting in both benchmarked runs.

legality_problems_in_authored_set: mega_slots 5,6 gives Sidney two Mega stones; the engine allows one Mega Evolution per trainer per battle, so Absolite Z is dead weight whenever Sharpedo enters first (it always does: slot 5 precedes slot 6). Either give Absol a different item or make Absol the sole Mega.

level_changes.rule_applied: KEEP (won with 5 faints after a real fight).
